trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the prize for finishing everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and the leftover counters — and this one takes care of itself.
steps: Play the story through Chapter 5.
Clear the 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion).
Finish the stranger strands and any counters still open.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 are done, at any point after the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — that screen is your checklist, and it opens once the story is done. Do not let the name fool you: this is not a true 100% of everything in the game, it is closer to 60% of it, so the list is long but finite. The big blocks are 200 of 277 base vehicle models (scan them with the WAiNK phone app), 100 of 255 animals (study them through binoculars), 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions, every robbery type, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race, and every Bret quest. Chip away at it in free roam after the story and the gold pops when the checklist hits 100%.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Scan vehicles with WAiNK (200 of 277 base models) and study animals with binoculars (100 of 255).
Collect 50 of 66 weapons and finish 70 of 80 challenges.
Do 100 optional missions, all robbery types, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and every Bret quest.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. The checklist stays open in free roam after the story; the only time-gated piece is the first meditation spot, which belongs to its own trophy.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts scattered across Leonida — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge passes, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you need 250 of them. The fastest route is the bridges: flying under them is quick to repeat and there are more than 200 of them. Track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find un-done spots under Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots. For the 100% checklist the bar rises to 300, so keep going past 250 if you want the platinum checklist too.
steps: Open Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see what is left near you.
Clear under-the-bridge passes first — 202 exist and they are the quickest.
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps until the counter hits 250.
Keep going to 300 if you are chasing the 100% checklist.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. Stunt spots stay on the map in free roam.

sources.fact: Breakdown 130 jumps / 202 bridges / 40 knife flights / 25 base jumps

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once. The tracker counts 9, and the story introduces most of them for you as you play — fishing, hunting, golf and the shooting range are among them, and the rest show up under Progress, then Activities. If one type is still untried late in the game, open that screen, see which one is missing, and go do a single round of it.
steps: Play the story — most activity types are introduced on the way.
Open Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you have not tried.
Do one round of each missing type.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. Every activity stays open in free roam.

sources.fact: Fishing, hunting, golf and shooting range among them

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 shooting range challenges across two ranges: the Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and the Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and a few stay locked until you meet their requirement, so do not panic if the list looks short at first. Gold every one of the 42 — use the range's own scoring feedback to learn what each challenge rewards, and repeat the ones you silver until they turn gold. Track them on the Touch Pad, under Activities, then Shooting Ranges.
steps: Visit both ranges: Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero.
Work through the challenges tier by tier; some unlock only after other requirements.
Replay any challenge that lands silver until it scores gold.
Check Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges for what is left.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. Both ranges stay open in free roam.

sources.role: PSN trophy target on the PSNProfiles trophy page

sources.fact: Three tiers per challenge; some locked behind requirements

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone time trials in total across those spots, and some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Learn each course's line first — a clean run beats a fast, crashing one — then race to win at every spot. Find them under Map, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.
steps: Open Map > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones to see the 14 locations.
Race each location; bring cash for entry fees where charged.
Win at all 14 locations (42 time trials total across them).
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. Drone races stay open in free roam.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different is the word that matters, because winning the same race twenty times counts once. Spread out across the race list and tick a new one off each time. Your car matters here: a well-rated car, upgraded at a Mod Shop, makes the later races far easier. Track wins under Activities, then Racing.
steps: Pick a strong car and upgrade it at a Mod Shop.
Race a new event each time — repeats of a won race do not count.
Win 20 different races in total.
trophies.missed: Cannot be missed. Races stay open in free roam.

steps: Take the fishing challenge from Cal.
Get a boat and a fishing rod, then head to the marked area on the map.
Catch a parrotfish over 2kg.
